title: Source-bound external availability scaling for surface irrigation

equations: if irr_rate>0 then dt_irr_event=dt_irr_event*f_irr_avail; otherwise event duration is unchanged

scope: isolated scalar task-4 materialization for the legacy surface rate and event duration
100000 deterministic source comparisons across positive and nonpositive irr_rate branches
non_goals: deriving external availability fraction or time-of-day coupling
SSDI qssdi/qssdisum behavior, accepted water amount or mass closure
event calendar, restart, transaction or production admission
pass_conditions: surface rate always scales by f_irr_avail
event duration scales only when irr_rate>0, preserving source branch strictness
100000 deterministic comparisons pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts
